correctness.rationale: Type-averaging preserves the source FJR+ linear-program witness. For one eligible type, max Z/Y is a/ell or b/ell. For both eligible without an unelected common candidate, any witness satisfies Y>=ell(s+t)-r min(s,t), where r is the common elected approvals; equality at ratios (s,t)=(1,0),(0,1),(1,1) follows by allocating r shared elected units and the remaining deficit to private unelected candidates. Piecewise fractional-linearity proves precisely four integer-level tests. With supported winners, p+q+r=k and both deficient imply 2ell-r>k; thus FJR+=EJR+. The explicit k=6 2+3 voter unsupported-winner example has utilities (2,3), r=2, ell=4, Y=6, Z=5, h=5/6 and separates FJR+ from FJR and EJR+. Independent combinatorial witness checks reproduced these figures; inspected LP script and its independent SciPy formulation, but did not execute all LP searches.
